cats.title: 🙈 Information
cats.intro: Users filter out much of what they receive — even important things.

items.name: Confirmation Bias
items.tag: People seek evidence for what they already believe

items.name: Cognitive Load
items.tag: Mental effort needed to complete a task

items.name: Anchoring Bias
items.tag: The first number/info seen sets the reference

items.name: Nudge
items.tag: Small cues steer choices without forcing

items.name: Fitts's Law
items.tag: Bigger, closer targets are faster to hit

items.name: Banner Blindness
items.tag: Users ignore what looks like ads

items.name: Decoy Effect
items.tag: A worse third option makes the target look better

items.name: Framing
items.tag: Presentation changes decisions more than facts do

items.name: Attentional Bias
items.tag: Current thoughts filter what users notice

items.name: Empathy Gap
items.tag: We underestimate emotion's pull on behaviour

items.name: Von Restorff Effect
items.tag: The odd one out gets noticed

items.name: Visual Hierarchy
items.tag: Order in which things are perceived

items.name: Survivorship Bias
items.tag: Ignoring what didn't make it through

items.name: Signifiers
items.tag: Cues that communicate what an element does

items.name: External Trigger
items.tag: The prompt contains the next step

items.name: Complexity–Arousal Curve
items.tag: Medium complexity liked most — on average

items.name: Fifty-Millisecond Impression
items.tag: Visual appeal is judged almost instantly

items.name: Visual Complexity Preference
items.tag: Simpler screens usually win first impressions

items.name: Symmetry Preference
items.tag: Symmetry pleases most people, not experts

items.name: Visual Balance
items.tag: Weighted elements feel settled around the centre

items.name: Rule of Thirds
items.tag: A useful habit, not a perceptual law

items.name: Fractal Fluency
items.tag: Nature-like mid-complexity patterns are easy and calming

cats.title: 🔮 Meaning
cats.intro: Users fill gaps with stories and assumptions to make sense of information.

items.name: Curiosity Gap
items.tag: Missing information creates a pull to fill it

items.name: Mental Model
items.tag: Users bring beliefs about how things work

items.name: Reciprocity
items.tag: Give value first, users give back

items.name: Singularity Effect
items.tag: One person moves us more than a crowd

items.name: Aha! Moment
items.tag: When users first get the value

items.name: Halo Effect
items.tag: One trait colours the whole judgment

items.name: Unit Bias
items.tag: One unit feels like the right amount

items.name: Group Attractiveness Effect
items.tag: Items look better in a group

items.name: Curse of Knowledge
items.tag: Experts forget what novices don't know

items.name: Self-Initiated Triggers
items.tag: Users respond to prompts they set

items.name: Survey Bias
items.tag: Answers skew to the socially acceptable

items.name: Law of Prägnanz
items.tag: Ambiguity is read in the simplest form

items.name: Spotlight Effect
items.tag: We think others notice us more than they do

items.name: Processing Fluency
items.tag: Easy to process feels good and true

items.name: MAYA Principle
items.tag: Most advanced, yet acceptable — novel but recognisable

items.name: Unity-in-Variety
items.tag: Coherence plus richness beats either alone

items.name: Curvature Preference
items.tag: Curves preferred over sharp angles, modestly

items.name: Golden Ratio
items.tag: 1.618 is folklore more than a law

items.name: Colour–Emotion Associations
items.tag: Colours carry shared, partly universal feelings

items.name: Peak Shift Effect
items.tag: Exaggerated defining features can beat the original

items.name: Aesthetic Aha
items.tag: Pleasure spikes when hidden order clicks

items.name: Visual Style Connotation
items.tag: How it looks says what it is

cats.title: ⏰ Time
cats.intro: Users are busy, take shortcuts and jump to conclusions.

items.name: Loss Aversion
items.tag: Losses hurt more than equal gains please

items.name: Commitment & Consistency
items.tag: Small yeses lead to bigger ones

items.name: Law of the Instrument
items.tag: With a hammer, everything's a nail

items.name: Discoverability
items.tag: Users can find features by looking

items.name: Parkinson's Law
items.tag: Work expands to fill the time

items.name: Cashless Effect
items.tag: Invisible money is spent more freely

items.name: Self-Serving Bias
items.tag: Credit for wins, blame for losses

items.name: False Consensus Effect
items.tag: We think others agree with us

cats.title: 💾 Memory
cats.intro: Users keep what seems important; the brain favours some elements over others.

items.name: Provide Exit Points
items.tag: Let users leave at the right moment

items.name: Peak-End Rule
items.tag: Experiences are judged by peaks and the ending

items.name: Endowment Effect
items.tag: Owning it makes it worth more

items.name: Chunking
items.tag: Grouped info is easier to remember

items.name: Shaping
items.tag: Reinforce steps toward a target behaviour
